adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS` is parsed with `split(",").map((email) => email.toLowerCase())` but never `trim()`ed. Since incoming `guests` are validated as emails (`z.array(z.string().email())`) they won’t contain leading spaces, so a typical env value like `"a@x.com, b@y.com"` yields `" b@y.com"` which will never match `guest === "b@y.com"` in `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`, making blacklist entries after the first ineffective.
